summary: Backend-only verification of Leads entity addition to master-data import template + raw full-session import defaults. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_leads_import.py (pytest, 7 tests) covering: (1) template.xlsx contains sheet 'Leads' with expected columns; (2) upload only-Leads template dry-run then commit → 3 inserts, verified persistence via /api/leads (stage=acquisition, phone starts with +62, assigned_to populated, score numeric); (3) re-import same file → 0 insert / 3 update (no duplicates); (4) row without phone → error 'No. HP wajib diisi'; (5) POST /api/data-mgmt/full/sessions with /tmp/leads.xlsx (77 rows) → leads sheet parsed with 77 rows, 0 errors; (6) POST /sessions/{sid}/commit body {mode:'update',sheets:['leads'],confirm:'IMPOR'} → totals.inserted=77, sampled leads (Nurmareta/Fauzi) show stage=acquisition, phone +62, assigned_to filled, score set; (7) automatic cleanup removes all TEST_* and raw-import demo leads. All 7 pytest tests PASSED. Post-run DB verified empty of test leads.
critical_code_review_comments: h_leads correctly upserts by phone, normalizes to +62, auto-assigns sales, and computes score — behavior matches request.
_lead_defaults in data_mgmt_full_session.py properly fills stage/source/assigned_to/score/phone for raw-imported minimal (name+phone) rows.
Minor: /api/leads response uses key 'data' (not 'items'); tests were adjusted accordingly. Consider documenting this consistently across similar list endpoints for FE consumers.

Cleanup query {created_by, source:'import', email:null} works because MongoDB treats null == missing for equality — good default. If email were ever imported as empty string '', it would leak; consider $in:[null,''] in future cleanup helpers.
seed_data_creation: 3 template TEST_ leads + 77 raw-file leads inserted during tests, all removed by test_zzz_cleanup_leads. Post-test count: 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_leads_import.py is idempotent when DB is clean at start. It uses module-scoped fixtures (token, template_bytes, raw_session). If run twice back-to-back, the earlier cleanup keeps state clean. The unique test phones are 081299999901..03 (→ +62...); avoid reusing.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Initial two failures during first test run were due to (a) motor client rejecting an env-loaded URL because MONGO_URL wasn't loaded in the pytest process — fixed by reading /app/backend/.env via python-dotenv; (b) test-1 dry_run reporting 0 inserts on second execution because prior-run cleanup had failed (issue a), leaving stale TEST_ leads. Once cleanup fixture worked, all 7 tests passed.
